channels.name: NVHS_TXp/TXn
channels.purpose: Differential transmit lane pair of a sub-link ('brick' = 8 pairs/direction).

channels.name: NVHS_RXp/RXn
channels.purpose: Differential receive lane pair of a sub-link; CDR recovers the embedded clock.
channels.active_levels: NVHS differential; CTLE+DFE; PAM4 four-level slicer at Gen4

channels.name: REFCLK
channels.purpose: Reference clock for the NVHS SerDes PLL.

global_signals.name: REFCLK
global_signals.purpose: Reference clock for the NVHS SerDes PLL.

handshake_pairs.name: Flit-ACK
handshake_pairs.rule: Acknowledge good flits so the transmitter retires them from the replay buffer.

handshake_pairs.name: Flit-Replay
handshake_pairs.rule: On CRC failure, request replay; transmitter retransmits the affected flit(s).

handshake_pairs.name: Read-Response
handshake_pairs.rule: A read returns a read-response flit carrying the data.

handshake_pairs.name: Atomic-Response
handshake_pairs.rule: An atomic returns an atomic-response flit.

handshake_pairs.name: Link-Training
handshake_pairs.rule: NVHS lane training / de-skew / alignment to reach Active.

dependency_graph.common_rule: Each lane recovers its own clock (CDR) and the 8 lane pairs of a sub-link de-skew before flit reassembly. TX and RX directions are independent (dual-simplex). Training/alignment must complete before flits flow; PAM4 (Gen4) adds eye-adaptation latency.
dependency_graph.data_dependency: A transaction requires: (1) the link Active (trained + aligned), (2) credits/replay-buffer space for the flit(s), (3) for reads/atomics, a returned response. Peer memory access additionally requires software-enabled peer mapping or NVSwitch routing.

logical_signaling_levels.name: Active flit stream
logical_signaling_levels.meaning: Continuously driven NVHS differential signaling carrying 16-byte flits (read/write/atomic transactions + CRC); NRZ (Gen1-3) or PAM4 (Gen4).

logical_signaling_levels.name: Electrical Idle
logical_signaling_levels.meaning: Transmitter undriven when the link is Down/Sleep.

logical_signaling_levels.name: Idle flit
logical_signaling_levels.meaning: Filler flits transmitted when Active with no transaction pending, keeping lanes aligned.

ordering_rules.bit_order_on_wire: Serial NVHS; NRZ (Gen1-3) two-level or PAM4 (Gen4) four-level symbols; flit boundaries established by lane alignment.
ordering_rules.lane_striping: Flit bytes striped across the 8 lane pairs of the sub-link; receiver de-skews.
ordering_rules.tx_rx_simultaneity: Dual-simplex: TX and RX directions transmit independently and simultaneously.
ordering_rules.transaction_ordering: Posted writes ordered within a virtual channel/traffic class; reads/atomics return responses; NVLink-C2C adds coherent ordering.
